overview_description.description: Merlin AI provides an AI-driven ERP system for construction companies. The platform automates estimating, procurement, scheduling, and project tracking. It unifies project management, customer management, financials, and supply chain operations into one system. The system supports AI-powered cost estimation, supplier tracking, and automated purchase orders. It offers AI-driven scheduling and workforce coordination to manage tasks and timelines. The platform includes financial automation, reporting, and forecasting tools for budgets and risk management.

product.name: Merlin AI ERP Platform
product.description: An AI-powered enterprise resource planning system designed for construction and modular building projects to streamline operations, manage resources, and optimize workflows.

product.name: Project Copilot
product.description: A module within Merlin AI that automates project tracking, task assignment, and deadline management to keep construction projects on schedule.

product.name: Operations Copilot
product.description: A Merlin AI module that monitors factory and site operations in real time, managing inventory and workflow automation for construction manufacturing.

product.name: Materials Copilot
product.description: A procurement and purchasing module that automates material acquisition workflows and enhances supply chain visibility for construction projects.

product.name: Finance Copilot
product.description: A financial management module that automates accounts payable and receivable, budgeting, and financial reporting for construction businesses.

product.name: Sales Copilot
product.description: A sales pipeline and CRM integration module that streamlines client management and accelerates deal closure for construction firms.
